recent_articles.title: Praful Patel and Sunil Tatkare conspired to take control of NCP: Rohit Pawar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NCP** leaders, including Sunil Tatkare, Praful Patel, and Brijmohan Srivastav, wrote to the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** requesting nullification of any correspondence related to party affairs between January 28, 2026, and the appointment of a new NCP president.  This action followed the death of former NCP chief Ajit Pawar on January 28, 2026, and the subsequent appointment of Sunetra Pawar as Deputy Chief Minister (DCM) and NCP president. **Rohit Pawar**, nephew of Sunetra Pawar and a member of the party, has accused these leaders of a pre-planned strategy to seize control of the party in Ajit Pawar's absence. He filed a Zero FIR in Bengaluru concerning the death of Ajit Pawar and alleged attempts at "black magic" rituals before his demise.

recent_articles.title: Jaishankar defends India’s stand as Opposition targets govt. on ‘Pak. mediation’ in West Asia - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **S. Jaishankar**, **External Affairs Minister**, stated that **Pakistan** has been acting as a mediator in U.S.-Iran relations since 1981, calling it a "dalal" and asserting India's strategic interests require maintaining a balanced position despite criticism from the Opposition.  The meeting addressed concerns about India's silence on Iran's attack on West Asian countries, the timing of Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**'s visit to Tel Aviv, and Pakistan's role in mediating between the U.S. and Iran. The meeting also saw questions regarding India's commitment to the Non-Aligned Movement and its economic implications from the ongoing crisis.

recent_articles.title: Zero FIR in Ajit Pawar crash an attempt to defame Maharashtra, says Fadnavis - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Maharashtra** Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis** stated that the zero FIR registered in Bengaluru regarding the plane crash that killed then Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar was an attempt by the neighboring **Karnataka** government to defame the state.  He clarified that a probe is underway by the Criminal Investigation Department and an Accidental Death Report (ADR) has been filed, adding that the state government had also requested a Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) probe as per the family's wishes. **Fadnavis** emphasized that the zero FIR was not intended to hinder an impartial probe and urged **Rohit Pawar**, Ajit Pawar’s nephew, to use legal avenues if he felt aggrieved.

recent_articles.title: Ajit Pawar’s nephew files complaint in Bengaluru against air crash; says Maharashtra police refused to file FIR - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A **Zero FIR** has been registered in Bengaluru based on a complaint filed by Maharashtra MLA Rohit Rajendra Pawar alleging a criminal conspiracy behind the death of former Maharashtra Deputy Chief Minister Ajit Pawar in a plane crash. The complaint, filed under Section 173(1) of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, claims systematic violations of aviation safety norms and gross negligence by **VSR Ventures Private Limited**, the aircraft operator.  The FIR cites findings from the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA), which found the aircraft to be negligent and not airworthy, leading to its grounding during the investigation. The complaint also raises concerns about the aircraft's history, including its prior use abroad and alleged underreporting of flight hours.

recent_articles.title: Transgender bill passed by voice vote in Lok Sabha - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Lok Sabha** passed the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Amendment Bill, 2026, by voice vote. The bill aims to redefine "transgender person" based on biological or physiological markers and socio-cultural identities, while opposition parties like the Congress, DMK, and SP argued that it violates basic human rights and undermines self-determination.  The government defended the bill as necessary for providing safety and benefits to the transgender community.

recent_articles.title: Govt revs up consultations on early implementation of Women’s Reservation Act - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Narendra Modi** government announced plans to amend the Women’s Reservation Act, 2023 to implement its provisions for the 2029 Lok Sabha election. The amendment will reserve one-third of seats in Parliament and State Assemblies for women based on the 2011 Census data.  The **Union Home Minister Amit Shah** met with leaders from various Opposition parties including the Nationalist Congress Party, YSR Congress Party, All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen, and Shiv Sena (UBT) to discuss the proposed amendments. The government aims to introduce these amendments in Parliament during the ongoing Budget Session or a Special Session later this year.

recent_articles.title: Opposition MPs, activists oppose amendments to Transgender Persons Act - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Members of Parliament and political party officials from across the country voiced strong opposition to a proposed amendment to the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019, at a public hearing in New Delhi.  **Rajya Sabha MPs** from various parties, including the **Rashtriya Janata Dal**, **Indian National Congress**, and the **Communist Party of India (Marxist)**, criticized the Bill's removal of transgender people's right to self-perceived gender identity and its introduction of a medical board for determining transgender status.  They argued that the government's actions were regressive and feared public backlash.

recent_articles.title: Opposition MPs, activists oppose amendments to Transgender Persons Act - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Members of Parliament** and officials from various political parties voiced strong opposition to the **Union government’s** proposed amendment to the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019.  At a public hearing held at the Press Club of India, **Rajya Sabha MPs** from the Rashtriya Janata Dal, Indian National Congress, and the Communist Party of India (Marxist) criticized the Bill's attempt to remove self-perceived gender identity recognition and introduce a medical board for determining transgender status.  They expressed concerns about the government’s motives and the potential impact on trans rights. The **Bill**, introduced in the Lok Sabha by **Union Social Justice Minister Virendra Kumar**, has drawn criticism from both trans communities and LGBTQ+ groups, who argue that it undermines the Act's purpose of protecting genuine transgender individuals.

recent_articles.title: NCP(SP) ‘unites’ behind Saseendran after Elathur candidate row - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: After weeks of internal conflict within the **Nationalist Congress Party (NCP)** in Kozhikode, a meeting led by **P.C. Chacko**, the party's national working president, resolved the dispute and unified the factions supporting Forest Minister A.K. Saseendran for his re-election bid from the Elathur Assembly constituency.  **Mukkom Mohammed**, the NCP(SP) Kozhikode district president, confirmed that all disagreements have been settled, with Mr. Chacko emphasizing the party's paramountcy.
